extra-ecff9c0564b1.zh-Hans:
主角=一个约35岁、身经百战的粗犷男人，饱经风霜的脸、深色胡茬、眉骨上一道伤口、一件脏污的白色背心、破旧的深色长裤和靴子、满是泥土和污垢。凶猛、疲惫、不屈。仅外观。

帮派1=一队粗犷的卡特尔打手，穿着脏污的休闲服装，不修边幅、凶恶，手持砍刀。仅外观。

帮派2=卡特尔执法者，穿着深色定制西装，纪律严明，手持利刃。仅外观。

老大=一个约45岁的卡特尔老大，锐利冷酷的脸、向后梳的灰白头发、修剪整齐的胡须、一尘不染的白色西装搭配深色衬衫。强大而具有威胁性。仅外观。

建筑=黄昏时分一个破败废弃的卡特尔藏身处——一栋肮脏废弃的混凝土建筑、一扇破旧的入口门、昏暗粗粝的一楼，墙壁剥落、裸露的灯泡、碎片和后方的一段楼梯，以及一个情绪化的上层，有高大的肮脏窗户和昏暗的光束。低饱和粗粝灰棕色调。仅环境。

场景：一段粗粝的单人军队动作序列。一个粗犷疲惫的男人穿着脏污的白色背心踢开废弃卡特尔藏身处的门，在一楼与一群手持砍刀的帮派搏斗，然后爬上上层，那里有穿西装的执法者和他们穿白色西装的老大在等待。他击倒执法者，并在最终决斗中击败老大，胜利站立。激烈、原始、电影化的武术动作。

技术：16:9，电影化粗粝低饱和灰色动作调色，动态手持打斗摄像机，低沉情绪化光线，灰尘和薄雾，细腻胶片颗粒，照片级真实原始动作质感。

剪辑：
剪辑1（0-5秒）：男人在黄昏走向肮脏的建筑，喊道“出来！”，踢开门——冲进昏暗的一楼，手持砍刀的打手们准备好武器。
剪辑2（5-12秒）：战斗爆发——残酷快速的徒手格斗，他躲避砍刀挥砍，在整个粗粝房间中利用柱子和家具逐个解除武装并击倒整个小队。动态变化的视角。
剪辑3（12-17秒）：房间清空，他大步走向楼梯并爬上上层——那里一队穿西装的执法者和他们身后穿白色西装的老大正在等待。紧张的对峙。
剪辑4（17-24秒）：执法者发动攻击；他在快速凶猛的战斗中击倒他们，直到只剩下老大。两人在光束照射的房间里面对面，喘着粗气。
剪辑5（24-30秒）：最终决斗——主角和老大在一对一中激烈交锋，交换重击，直到主角打出决定性最后一击，老大倒在地上，被击败。主角站在他上方，胜利，在昏暗的光束中。史诗般的最终主角画面。结束。

规则：参考仅用于外观，不要重新创建。保持主角的脸和白色背心，以及老大的白色西装，在整个过程中保持一致

创建一个16:9的电影化黑暗奇幻变形。一个真实的成年男子，短深色头发、浅色胡茬、黑色衣服，独自站在夜晚寒冷多雾的松树林中。全程保持相同的脸、身体、发型和身份。

0–3秒：中景正面镜头。他微微前倾，双手抱住头两侧，沉重呼吸。缓慢推近。蓝灰色月光和飘动的雾。

3–6秒：紧凑特写。他的下颌紧咬，表情加剧，眼睛逐渐发出琥珀橙色光芒。太阳穴、脸颊和脖子周围出现毛发；耳朵慢慢变尖。

6–10秒：连续真实变形：脸变成狼形，下颌延伸，牙齿变尖，深棕灰色毛发蔓延到头部、肩膀、手臂和躯干。身体变得更高更强壮。没有瞬间变形、剪辑、血液或血腥。

10–12秒：摄像机拉远，展现一只完全变形的真实狼人，发光的琥珀色眼睛、浓密毛发、肌肉发达的身体、带爪的手、狼一样的腿和自然的尾巴。树后是满月。

12–15秒：戏剧性全身广角镜头。狼人站在雾中，沉重呼吸，毛发在风中飘动，然后慢慢向月亮抬起头。

风格：超真实真人实拍、电影化VFX、体积月光、深阴影、真实毛发、自然解剖结构、景深、微妙的运动模糊和胶片颗粒。声音：森林风声、沉重呼吸、低沉低音轰鸣、变形声音和深沉咆哮。恰好一个男人变成一个狼人。没有重复、额外生物、额外肢体、卡通外观或畸形解剖结构。

纯属虚构的荒诞动作短片。100%真实手机实拍质感，iPhone纪录片风格，30秒手持一镜到底，无剪辑、无转场。自然日光，轻微呼吸式镜头运动，偶发自动对焦迟疑，轻微滚动快门，真实动态模糊，镜头边缘带少量指纹和灰尘。所有变形、机械运动、撞击和碎片效果都必须具有沉重的现实物理反馈，呈现为全尺寸机械装置与实景特效，绝不能出现电子游戏、动画或廉价CG质感。保留现场原始声音和路人的真实反应。 环境 午后，一家繁忙的鸿蒙智行·智界授权汽车门店停车场。 巨大的落地玻璃展厅内停着数辆新车，销售人员正陪顾客看车。停车场车辆进出不断，工作人员拿着平板在车位间穿梭，几名顾客围着一辆停在室外展示区的紫色智界R7拍照。 现场充满城市车流声、轮胎碾过沥青的声音、门店广播、远处交谈声、鸟鸣和偶尔响起的车辆提示音。一切都像路人偶然拍下、即将病毒式传播的手机视频。 门店原有标识可以自然出现在环境中，但不添加字幕、广告标题或浮动文字。 主角 一位二十五岁左右的成年年轻美女
，身材和穿着严格参考
HO2iXF9a4AAZsco
。 她神态放松，右手拿着一个传统竹制发声玩具“竹知了”。竹知了由短竹筒、细绳和小竹片组成。她一边经过停车场，一边漫不经心地转动竹知了。 竹知了发出连续、滑稽而响亮的“呜哇、呜哇”鸣叫声。 她并不是超级英雄，没有盔甲，不发生身体变形，始终保持普通成年女性的真实外貌。 关键车辆 停车场中央只有一辆紫色智界R7发生变形。 必须准确保持紫色车漆、轿跑SUV车身比例、贯穿式前灯、车轮、车门、玻璃和车身覆盖件的视觉连续性。车辆内部无人，没有驾驶员和乘客。 变形过程必须清晰可读：车轮折叠成为肩部结构，车门展开成为前臂护甲，底盘向下延伸形成双腿，车头与贯穿式灯带上升成为胸部，紫色车顶折叠成机器人头部。所有零件均来自同一辆车，不凭空增加零件，不突然更换车型或颜色。 30秒连续镜头 镜头开始于美女右后方约一米半、与肩膀同高的位置。摄影者跟随她缓缓进入停车场，让她的上半身、手里的竹知了以及前方紫色智界R7同时处于画面中。 镜头不能突然飞起，不能切换机位，也不能拉远成为俯瞰全景。 美女一边走，一边悠闲地转动竹知了。连续的“呜哇、呜哇”声在停车场里格外明显。 几名销售人员和顾客好奇地回头看她，但没有人太在意。 突然，紫色智界R7的贯穿式灯带自行亮起。 她握紧细绳，突然加快手腕旋转速度。 竹知了的鸣叫声变得越来越急促。 “呜哇——呜哇——呜哇——” 竹筒内部开始透出淡淡的金色光芒。 光芒越来越强。 十个、数百个、成千上万个发光的竹知了在她身体周围凭空出现，像一群完美同步的金色蜂群，在她头顶和肩膀周围高速盘旋。 旋转产生的强风吹动她的长发和衣角，将停车场里的宣传单、树叶、灰尘和塑料袋全部卷入空中。金色光芒映在周围汽车的玻璃与金属车漆上。 巨型机器人挥动紫色机械手臂，试图拍散竹知了群。机械拳头擦过地面，掀起碎石和尘土。 美女侧身迈开一步避过冲击，双脚重新站稳，身体重心压低，右手仍然牢牢控制细绳。 她突然将竹知了高高举起…… ……然后打了一个清脆的响指。 所有发光的竹知了瞬间向前发射。 天空被无数道金色轨迹划破。 第一批竹知了像精准制导的蜂群，猛烈撞击机器人的膝关节和脚踝；第二批绕着机器人高速盘旋，钻入肩部车轮、车门手臂和胸口灯带之间的机械缝隙。 机器人踉跄后退，机械脚掌在沥青上拖出两道深深的沟槽。它挥拳反击，却不断打空，每一次挥动都带起真实而沉重的气流。 最后一批竹知了在机器人胸前汇聚成高速旋转的金色圆环。 美女猛然向下一拉细绳。 所有竹知了同时发出一声震耳欲聋的巨大鸣叫。 一道肉眼可见的环形空气冲击波正面撞上机器人胸口。 在这一瞬间进入短暂慢动作：紫色机器人全身的机械锁扣依次弹开，车门护甲、车轮、玻璃、底盘和车身覆盖件在空中分离；金色竹知了从零件之间高速穿过，飞散的螺栓、灰尘和细小玻璃颗粒悬浮在阳光中。 这不是爆炸，也不是车辆被彻底摧毁。所有零件仍然属于同一辆紫色智界R7，没有火焰，没有人员受伤。 慢动作结束。 extra-73f6cc142999.en: A purely fictional absurd action short film. 100% authentic smartphone footage texture, iPhone documentary style, 30-second handheld single continuous take, no cuts, no transitions. Natural daylight, slight breathing-style camera movement, occasional autofocus hesitation, slight rolling shutter, realistic motion blur, a small amount of fingerprints and dust at the edges of the lens. All transformation, mechanical movement, impact and debris effects must have heavy realistic physical feedback, presented as full-scale mechanical devices and practical effects, and must absolutely not have a video game, animation or cheap CG texture. Preserve the original on-site sound and the real reactions of passersby. Environment: Afternoon, in the parking lot of a busy HIMA (Harmony Intelligent Mobility Alliance) · Luxeed authorized car dealership. Inside the huge floor-to-ceiling glass showroom, several new cars are parked, and sales staff are accompanying customers looking at cars. Vehicles continuously enter and exit the parking lot, staff members shuttle between parking spaces holding tablets, and several customers gather around a purple Luxeed R7 parked in the outdoor display area taking photos. The scene is full of city traffic noise, the sound of tires rolling over asphalt, dealership broadcasts, distant conversations, birdsong and occasional vehicle alert tones. Everything looks like a smartphone video accidentally captured by a passerby and about to go viral. The dealership's original signage can naturally appear in the environment, but no subtitles, advertising titles or floating text are added. Protagonist: An adult young beautiful woman around twenty-five years old, whose figure and clothing strictly reference HO2iXF9a4AAZsco. She looks relaxed, holding a traditional bamboo sound-making toy "bamboo cicada" in her right hand. The bamboo cicada consists of a short bamboo tube, a thin string and a small bamboo piece. As she passes through the parking lot, she casually twirls the bamboo cicada. The bamboo cicada emits a continuous, comical and loud "wu-wa, wu-wa" chirping sound. She is not a superhero, has no armor, does not undergo body transformation, and always maintains the realistic appearance of an ordinary adult woman. Key vehicle: Only one purple Luxeed R7 in the center of the parking lot transforms. It must accurately maintain the visual continuity of the purple paint, coupe SUV body proportions, full-width front light bar, wheels, doors, glass and body panels. There is no one inside the vehicle, no driver and no passengers. The transformation process must be clearly readable: the wheels fold into shoulder structures, the doors unfold into forearm armor, the chassis extends downward to form legs, the front end and full-width light strip rise to become the chest, and the purple roof folds into the robot's head. All parts come from the same car, no parts are added out of thin air, and the model or color does not suddenly change. 30-second continuous shot: The shot begins about one and a half meters behind and to the right of the beautiful woman, at shoulder height. The photographer follows her slowly into the parking lot, keeping her upper body, the bamboo cicada in her hand and the purple Luxeed R7 ahead simultaneously in frame. The camera must not suddenly fly up, must not switch camera positions, and must not pull back into an overhead panoramic view. As the beautiful woman walks, she leisurely twirls the bamboo cicada. The continuous "wu-wa, wu-wa" sound is particularly noticeable in the parking lot. Several sales staff and customers curiously turn their heads to look at her, but no one pays much attention. Suddenly, the full-width light strip of the purple Luxeed R7 lights up on its own. With each sound of the bamboo cicada, the R7's lights flash in sync. The beautiful woman gradually slows her pace. A low metallic vibration sound comes from inside the body of the Luxeed R7. The suspension suddenly sinks, all four tires rub against the ground at the same time, and the alarms of nearby vehicles sound one after another. The entire purple R7 suddenly begins to transform. The hood splits open to both sides, the doors rotate and unfold, the wheels leave the ground and lock into the shoulders; the chassis extends downward, and two heavy mechanical legs slam onto the asphalt surface, cracking it into a spiderweb pattern. The purple Luxeed R7 stands up in the center of the parking lot, turning into a giant robot several stories tall. The parking lot instantly falls into panic. Customers drop brochures and coffee and scatter in all directions. Sales staff duck behind display cars to hide. Shopping bags, flyers and sun hats are swept into the air by the airflow generated by the robot rising. Two cars that are reversing collide slightly, and their horns keep honking. The robot lets out a heavy mechanical roar, swings its huge arm made of car doors, and bends a light pole in the parking lot. It then raises its mechanical foot and crushes an empty display stand nearby, sending concrete fragments and dust flying in all directions. The photographer panics, backs away and dodges sideways, and the camera shakes violently. Small flying fragments hit near the lens, autofocus briefly loses accuracy, and then locks back onto the robot. The camera quickly returns to the beautiful woman. Everyone is running away. She barely reacts. She calmly looks up at the giant robot... ...then looks down at the bamboo cicada in her hand. The robot turns its body, its purple metal foot scraping across the ground, and takes a heavy step toward her. Each step makes the parking lot ground tremble, and the glass showroom shakes with it. The beautiful woman merely raises one eyebrow slightly. She grips the thin string tightly and suddenly speeds up the rotation of her wrist. The chirping of the bamboo cicada becomes faster and faster. "Wu-wa—wu-wa—wu-wa—" A faint golden light begins to shine from inside the bamboo tube. The light grows stronger and stronger. Ten, hundreds, thousands of glowing bamboo cicadas appear out of thin air around her body, like a perfectly synchronized golden swarm, circling rapidly above her head and around her shoulders. The strong wind generated by the rotation blows her long hair and the hem of her clothes, sweeping all the flyers, leaves, dust and plastic bags in the parking lot into the air. The golden light reflects on the glass and metal paint of the surrounding cars. The giant robot swings its purple mechanical arm, trying to swat away the swarm of bamboo cicadas. The mechanical fist grazes the ground, kicking up gravel and dust. The beautiful woman steps sideways to avoid the impact, plants her feet firmly again, lowers her center of gravity, and still firmly controls the string with her right hand. She suddenly raises the bamboo cicada high... ...and then snaps her fingers crisply. All the glowing bamboo cicadas instantly launch forward. The sky is torn by countless golden trails. The first batch of bamboo cicadas, like a precisely guided swarm, violently strikes the robot's knee joints and ankles; the second batch circles rapidly around the robot and drills into the mechanical gaps between the shoulder wheels, door arms and chest light strip. The robot staggers backward, its mechanical feet dragging two deep grooves in the asphalt. It swings its fists to fight back, but keeps missing, and each swing brings up a real and heavy airflow.
